contexts.text: Armageddon = a state of combat from falsities against truths, and a disposition to destroy the New Church arising from the love of rule and of preeminence.
In Heaven, Armageddon = the love of honour, of rule, and of pre-eminence, and in Hebrew also aram or arom = loftiness, and in old Hebrew, Megiddo = love from loftiness. Illustrated. AE 1010.
An army of armageddoni, seen and described. TCR 113.
In Heaven, Armageddon = the state and disposition to combat from falsified truths, arising from the love of rule and of pre-eminence.
(Report of a long discussion between Angels and the armageddoni).
On attempting to do violence to the Angels they were struck blind.
